name: yahtzee
title: Yahtzee
description: Solo Yahtzee: five dice, three rolls a round, thirteen rounds. The card shows what every category would score with the dice as they lie; play with the mouse or one-handed on the arrows, Enter and space. The game in progress, the best score and the average persist.
author: pal

store.tagline: Solo Yahtzee with the scores in plain sight; mouse or one hand on the keys
features: Five ivory dice that tumble when thrown (held ones stay put), a scorecard in two columns under them, the total at the bottom; everything fits the panel at once, compact included
The card shows what each open category would score with the dice as they lie, and the dice a category counts light up while its row is picked; the total shows what it would add (`+25`)

One-handed: `←` `→` pick a die and Enter holds it, `↑` or `space` rolls, `↓` lands on the category that adds most, the arrows move between the open ones and Enter scores; `1` to `5` hold and `R` rolls too
The upper bonus as a bar to 63, with the picked category's share in a lighter shade; greyed once it is out of reach
Hasbro's rules in full: 35 for 63 in the upper section, 100 for each further Yahtzee while the Yahtzee box holds 50, and the Joker rules for where it may go
A Yahtzee gets a banner and confetti, a score drops into its row while the total counts up, game over shows the final score with the best and the average
Escape leaves at any point; the game and the record are there when you come back, across restarts

screenshots.caption: Mid-round: three fours held, each open category showing what it would score
Out of rolls: the cursor on the card, the dice it counts ringed, the total showing what it adds
A second Yahtzee in the dark theme: 100 more, and as a Joker it fills a straight
Game over: the final score with the best and the average
